finding.statement: The stronger main fusion preserved timestamp/narration replay stability but accidentally reintroduced delta_id into CLAY_FORGE_EXECUTION_REPLAY_IDENTITY/v1 and left delta_id inside CLAY_FORGE_MEASURED_EVIDENCE_IDENTITY/v1. Because delta_id names the candidate/evaluation envelope rather than a new measured execution, renaming only delta_id changes both digests and can make the same measured execution independently admissible, permitting duplicate Distillery packets/tokens.
finding.donor_evidence: Closed PR #1687 explicitly excluded delta_id and included test_delta_id_only_replay_is_duplicate; that unique regression was not preserved in tests/test_forge_distillery_replay_identity_873.py when the stronger main fusion was created.
finding.legacy_gap: The main legacy replay fence also keyed on delta_id, so a renamed envelope could bypass the fail-closed LEGACY_REPLAY_IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED collision check.

hypothesis: Treating delta_id as volatile envelope identity while binding execution/provenance/targets/admission/metric prevents nonsemantic replay token inflation without collapsing genuinely distinct execution evidence.
counterhypothesis: delta_id may safely distinguish independent measurements.
counterhypothesis_disposition: REJECTED_AT_CURRENT_SOURCE_CONTRACT: the original replay-stable donor explicitly classifies delta_id as candidate/evaluation envelope identity, while measured execution identity is already bound by worker/source/evaluation heads, target blobs, execution admission, provider/model/role and metric.

changes: make legacy replay collision conservative across delta_id renaming
restore explicit delta-id-only semantic replay +0 regression

tracks.B_HCU_AND_TYPED_ENTRY_FABRIC_CO_DEVELOPM: ADVANCED: sharpens the reusable causal identity boundary between execution evidence and transport/evaluation envelope identity.
